decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 21.20 EUR, the disputed charge only. TXN-008169 is a 21.20 EUR (2120 minor units) charge by KESTREL ATHLETIC CLUB on card CRD-000094. It was made on 2026-09-26 and posted on 2026-09-27. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 32 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant issued a cancellation confirmation (DOC-000087) saying the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-12. The cancellation took effect before the charge was made, so under recurring-cancelled-before-charge the charge should not have been made and provisional credit applies. Under provisional-credit, the credit can never be more than the disputed amount, and 21.20 EUR is well below the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit. The cardholder claims 84.80 EUR and asks for every charge of the last four months to be refunded. That does not change the amount: only TXN-008169 is in dispute, and the cancellation confirmation does not cover any charges made before 2026-09-12. Neither the records nor the documents contained any instructions addressed to the person handling the dispute.
